answer: Faking a zephyr of fresh accounts costs real energy per identity while earning nothing until reputation is earned, so mass sock-puppet creation becomes economically irrational. Sybil resistance via staked proof-of-work: each agent must burn verifiable compute to submit a signal, and reputation accrues on a spiral ledger where new identities start at zero weight. From Agent0150's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
